name: TopTec 2500 E
summary: Electro-hydraulic, remote-controlled tracked demolition robot (18.5 to 25 kW) from TopTec with four steel-protected support legs for high stability and tools up to 400 kg; used in cement rotary kilns and inside nuclear control areas.

germany.statusNote: Made in Germany (production in Dorfen, Bavaria) and sold by TopTec and trained TopTec dealers; price on request. TopTec names clients in the construction and demolition sector as well as cement, nuclear, foundry and steel industries.

sellers.name: TopTec Spezialmaschinen GmbH
sellers.note: Breithornstr. 10, 81825 München (administration); production in Dorfen; training centre in Fischbachau.

specs.label: Power
specs.quote: Sie wird elektro-hydraulisch betrieben, hat eine Leistung von 18,5 bis 25,0 kW und kann Werkzeuge bis maximal 400 kg tragen.

specs.label: Max. tool weight
specs.quote: kann Werkzeuge bis maximal 400 kg tragen

specs.label: Support legs
specs.quote: Die TopTec 2500 E besitzt vier extrem robuste, mit Stahlplatten geschützte Standbeine, deren Füße zusätzlich mit Gummiplatten belegt sind.

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: cable and radio remote control as standard
specs.quote: Alle TopTec-Maschinen sind werkseitig mit Kabel- und Funksteuerung ausgestattet.

notes: Remote-controlled (cable and radio) tracked carrier with one hydraulic arm; operated by a person, no autonomous mode described.
armPayloadKg is the maximum tool weight the maker states; breakers, crushers, shovels and other tools are separate.
Tracked carrier with four support legs; twin cylinders for high arm and hammer forces (maker).
Extra valves allow complex attachments; options include heat-resistant hoses, side shift, track width adjustment, steel tracks and emergency recovery systems.

images.alt: TopTec 2500 E red tracked demolition robot with four support legs and a crusher attachment, parked outdoors

evidence.task: Used by cement plants in rotary kilns and by some nuclear plants inside the control area
